fact: The Ministry of Health's statistical yearbook for 2022 states that health facilities send paper reports to the health zone before the 5th of each month and the zone keys them before the 20th, entry being done in every health zone on the single DHIS2 platform, and that the 2022 validation workshop brought together the statisticians of the health zones and of public and private hospitals to check the data keyed in the zones and the hospitals.
title: Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2022
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, Direction de la Planification, de l'Administration et des Finances (SNIGS-MS)
